name: asc-testflight-orchestration
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: A paid Apple Developer Program account.
The asc CLI on PATH with an App Store Connect API key (the .p8 key downloads only once).
risks: Emails tester invitations and distributes builds (SKILL.md:21-26); only removing groups needs --confirm.
errata: Omits that the first build in an external group needs Beta App Review (`builds add-groups ... --submit --confirm`, asc CLI README:281) and test information.
